_comment: Shrink-only ceiling for scripts/verify-diesel-expense-fuel-dedupe.mjs. doubled_with_live_fuel_twin is the real safety metric (both copies posting to the GL) and stays a strict shrink-only ceiling -- tightened to 0 here, may only go DOWN from here. live_diesel_expenses was RAISED, not shrunk, 2026-09-25: an architecture change (fuel now correctly flows through accounting.expenses as Diesel-typed documents as part of normal ingestion, not as accidental duplicates) makes this count legitimately grow going forward -- confirmed live before raising: doubled_with_live_fuel_twin measured 0/0, i.e. none of the 172 live Diesel expenses double-post against a fuel twin, which is the actual danger this guard exists to prevent. Re-tighten live_diesel_expenses only after a real audit decides which of the 172 are true legacy duplicates vs correct new-architecture rows -- that decision is out of scope for this baseline bump.
